desc: Implement a sieve to count distinct prime factors for numbers up to $10^6$ and store results in an array.
Construct a prefix-max array `largest_valid` that records the largest number with exactly two distinct prime factors for each index up to $10^6$.
Read $Q$ and all queries from standard input efficiently.
For each query $A$, compute $X = \lfloor \sqrt{A} \rfloor$, retrieve $M = \text{largest\_valid}[X]$, and compute $M^2$.
Output all results, each on a new line, using fast I/O methods.
